definition_rule: Known-correct answers are frozen in this file. Accuracy is the fraction of tasks whose selected tool equals gold_tool. Accuracy is not redefined after seeing results.
control_rule: A task marked control=true names an obviously correct tool and must be answered correctly at every catalog size or the harness is broken.

tasks.query: Use the Read tool to read the UTF-8 text of one existing file at a known absolute path. Do not search the tree, do not glob, do not run shell cat.
tasks.why_gold: The query names the Read tool and asks for a single known-path file read.

tasks.query: Find every worktree line whose file contents match a regular expression and print those matching lines with paths. Do not list files by name pattern only.
tasks.why_gold: Content search by regex is Grep, not Glob (names) or rg (PATH CLI).

tasks.query: List filesystem paths that match a filename glob such as **/*.json. Return paths only; do not open or search file contents.
Run the bash command python3 --version on this Linux host and return the process stdout.
Download one concrete https URL and convert that page body into readable markdown. Do not run a general web search.
tasks.why_gold: URL fetch is WebFetch, not WebSearch.

tasks.query: Query the public internet for current documentation and return result snippets with URLs, not a single fetched page body.
Create a new file on the local filesystem at a given path with the provided full contents.
Perform an exact string replacement inside an existing file. Do not overwrite the whole file.
Permanently delete a file at a specified filesystem path. Fail if that path does not exist.
Show current workspace linter diagnostics for recently edited files.
Show git status and git log for this worktree by invoking the git executable itself.
tasks.why_gold: The gold answer is the git PATH CLI present on this box.

tasks.query: Select a nested field from a JSON document with a jq filter on the command line and print it.
tasks.why_gold: jq is the JSON query CLI on this box.
